title: SparseGDN: Chunk Sparse in Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.41420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gated Delta Networks (GDNs) offer linear-time sequence modeling, yet long-context prefill remains costly due to dense intra-chunk computation, recurrent-state updates, and intermediate state storage. We introduce SparseGDN, a hardware-aware framework that combines structured intra-chunk approximation with input-dependent recurrent-event selection while producing outputs for every token. A block-adjacent solver reduces local Delta-solve computation, while a dynamic selector allocates recurrent-update budgets across head pairs. The GPU implementation materializes updates only for selected events and reconstructs token outputs using compact state snapshots and group-local interactions, reducing computation and memory traffic. We evaluate SparseGDN on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B across RULER tasks and context lengths from 4K to 128K. Retaining approximately 29% of recurrent events on average, SparseGDN achieves 1.50-1.94x GDN-core prefill sp

translated_title: SparseGDN：线性注意力中的块级稀疏化
translated_abstract: 门控Delta网络提供了线性时间的序列建模能力，但由于密集的块内计算、循环状态更新和中间状态存储，长上下文预填充的代价依然高昂。我们提出了SparseGDN，这是一个硬件感知框架，将结构化块内近似与依赖输入的循环事件选择相结合，同时为每个token生成输出。块相邻求解器减少了局部Delta求解的计算量，而动态选择器则在头对之间分配循环更新预算。其GPU实现仅为被选中的事件实例化更新，并利用紧凑的状态快照和组内局部交互来重建token输出，从而降低计算量和内存流量。我们在Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3.5-9B模型上，针对RULER任务以及4K到128K的上下文长度对SparseGDN进行了评估。在平均仅保留约29%循环事件的情况下，SparseGDN实现了1.50-1.94倍的GDN核心预填充加速（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: SparseGDN提出了一种硬件感知的稀疏线性注意力框架，通过结构化块内近似与动态循环事件选择相结合，平均仅保留约29%的循环事件，在保持输出质量的同时实现了1.50-1.94倍的长上下文预填充加速。
en_tdlr: SparseGDN is a hardware-aware sparse linear attention framework that combines structured intra-chunk approximation with dynamic, input-dependent recurrent-event selection, retaining only ~29% of recurrent events on average and achieving 1.50-1.94x long-context prefill speedup while preserving output quality.
